items.raw_excerpt: Felicity Guest says frozen child support payments are a result of suspicious activity

items.raw_excerpt: Un itinerario tra i luoghi dell'anima del cantautore, dalle radici nell'Appennino alla Bologna delle osterie e della musica
items.summary_en: This story follows the places that inspired the songs of Italian singer-songwriter Francesco Guccini. It goes from his roots in the Apennine mountains to Bologna and its taverns and music. Fans can explore the spots that shaped his work.

items.raw_excerpt: It took decades for Yessika Sutawijaya to meet another person with neurofibromatosis. The experience inspired the 45-year-old to co-found a support group so others with the rare condition can find the support and community she never had.
items.summary_en: Yessika Sutawijaya, 45, waited many years to meet another person with neurofibromatosis. She then co-founded a support group. Now others with the rare condition can find the support and community she never had.
